slides.subline: Momos Coffee, Oncheonjang — a Busan roastery that began in a converted storage room in 2007 and placed 22nd on The World's 100 Best Coffee Shops 2026

slides.label: Momos Coffee's place on The World's 100 Best Coffee Shops 2026 — one of only two Korean cafes on the list, and the one that is not in Seoul
slides.note: Sources: The World's 100 Best Coffee Shops 2026, announced at Coffee Fest Madrid on 16 February 2026 · Haps Korea · Stripes Korea · The Korea Herald, April 2026

items.d: Jooyeon Jeon of Momos won in Boston — the first Korean to take the title, and, as the company notes, the first winner from outside the capital region
That year's champion, Kyoungha 'Charlie' Chu, later joined Momos and now oversees quality control from green bean selection to roast, per the company's own account
The 100 Best list combines expert judging with public voting; Seoul's Lurii Coffee was the only other Korean entry, at 51

slides.title:
The title came out of
a neighbourhood, not a capital.
slides.body:
Korean coffee prestige is assumed to live in Seoul. Momos is the counter-example, and its start was small: the company says it opened in 2007 by converting a restaurant storage room of about 140 square feet into a take-out coffee bar. Haps Korea places that first shop in Oncheonjang, the district where the flagship still stands.

What grew out of it was a roasting company rather than a cafe chain — an academy, wholesale, and direct sourcing from what Momos reports as more than 150 partner farms. In 2019 its co-CEO Jooyeon Jeon won the World Barista Championship in Boston: the first Korean champion, and the first from outside the capital region.
slides._note: the real message of this post

items.d: The Korea Tourism Organization lists the main branch here, near Oncheonjang Station on Line 1, exit 2, and notes there is no parking. The Korea Herald describes a wood-toned room opening onto a courtyard with bamboo and a magnolia
Per the tourism listing; Visit Busan adds closures on public holidays and Labour Day. Phone numbers differ between listings (051-512-0700 and 051-512-7034), so confirm before travelling

items.t: Hand drip is the house format, and it is slow
items.d: Visit Busan lists today's drip coffee at 6,500 won and an americano chocolat at 6,000 won; the Korea Herald reported waits of over half an hour for hand drip

caption:
The 2019 World Barista Champion wasn't working in Seoul.

Momos Coffee has been roasting in Busan's Oncheonjang since 2007, and in February it placed 22nd on The World's 100 Best Coffee Shops 2026 — one of only two Korean cafes on the list.

Hours and prices shift, and taste is personal.
